PLAN "Postpartum Return - 12 Weeks (Phase 2 gated on 6-week OB clearance)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary recovery:
    name "Safe postpartum return to general fitness"
  GOAL secondary conditioning:
    name "Build walking capacity and bodyweight strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Gentle Return (light activity only)" (6 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Breath and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          neck_roll 1x5 rpe 2 rest 15 seconds
          arm_circles 1x10 rpe 2 rest 15 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Breath and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 1x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Breath and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
